encoding_explanation: Why Label Encoding is Invalid for Distance-Based Clustering: Label encoding assigns arbitrary integer ranks (e.g. Buffalo=0, Cow=1, Goat=2, Sheep=3). In Euclidean and Manhattan distance, (Sheep - Buffalo) = 3 - 0 = 3, while (Cow - Buffalo) = 1 - 0 = 1. This artificially imposes an untrue linear metric hierarchy where Sheep is treated as 3x farther from Buffalo than Cow is. K-Means and K-Medians treat these numbers as spatial coordinates in metric space, corrupting distance calculations. One-Hot and Multi-Hot binary encoding place each category on an orthogonal basis vector with equal pairwise distances, maintaining objective metric neutrality.

decision_log.what_was_done: Audited 43,778 records across 7 columns for missingness, data types, and value validity.
decision_log.reason: Ensure data integrity before applying unsupervised distance-based algorithms.
decision_log.impact: Confirmed zero missing values, valid physiological ranges (Age: 1-15 yr, Temp: 100-105 F).

decision_log.what_was_done: Extracted 'Disease' column into an isolated ground-truth vector and removed from clustering input.
decision_log.reason: Unsupervised pattern discovery requirement: clustering must not be contaminated by diagnostic labels.
decision_log.impact: Guarantees zero target leakage. All downstream clusters represent genuine unsupervised phenotype groupings.

decision_log.what_was_done: Converted 'Animal' into 4 binary one-hot indicators (animal_buffalo, animal_cow, animal_goat, animal_sheep).
decision_log.reason: Label encoding (0,1,2,3) assigns artificial Euclidean distances between nominal species. One-hot encoding creates orthogonal dimensions with equal pairwise distance.
decision_log.impact: Preserved equal metric distance between all livestock species.

decision_log.what_was_done: Aggregated 3 positional symptom columns into a 24-dimensional binary presence/absence indicator matrix.
decision_log.reason: Symptom recording order (Symptom 1 vs 2 vs 3) is arbitrary. Separate one-hot encoding would produce 72 sparse variables and treat same symptom in different positions as distinct features.
decision_log.impact: Eliminated positional bias, reduced feature dimensionality from 72 to 24, and created true clinical Hamming/Manhattan distance space.

decision_log.what_was_done: Applied StandardScaler (Z-score normalization) to Age and Temperature. Kept binary flags in {0, 1}.
decision_log.reason: Unscaled Age (1-15) and Temperature (100-105) have vastly different ranges and would dominate Euclidean distance over binary symptom indicators. Binary features are left in {0,1} to maintain exact Hamming distance semantics.
decision_log.impact: Normalized numeric variance (mean=0, std=1) balanced against binary symptom indicators.

decision_log.what_was_done: Audited exact duplicates (0) and feature duplicates (3,618). Retained feature duplicates after verifying clinical validity.
decision_log.reason: In agricultural herd medicine, multiple animals naturally present identical symptom triplets. Dropping duplicates would distort cluster density and true epidemiological prevalence.
decision_log.impact: Full observational sample (N=43,778) retained without artificial population skew.
